name: ai-thinking
title: AI Thinking Trace
description: Architectural expandable reasoning trace accordion with duration counter, categorized tabs (Steps, Reasoning, Search, Coding), and execution step cards.

props.name: steps
props.description: Array of execution steps with status, duration, and details

props.name: reasoningText
props.description: Narrative explanation of architectural decision making

props.name: codeExecutions
props.description: Code snippets evaluated with outputs and latency

examples.title: Architectural Reasoning Trace
examples.description: Collapsible thinking container with step-by-step verification cards.
examples.code:
<AiThinking
  status="completed"
  duration="3.8s"
  steps={steps}
  reasoningText="Evaluating boundary conditions for low-latency buffer allocation."
/>
